question: Panche is a traditional sarong worn by the men in the state of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panche**__ 

 __
 
• Panche is a non-stitched cloth is wrapped around the legs and knotted around the waist.
 
• Panche is aesthetically worn by the men of Karnataka.
 
• Its other name is Dhoti.
 
• It is a rectangular piece of cloth of 4.5 metres long.
 
• Karnataka men pair their panches with a shirt to various occasions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karnataka**__

 
 
• Capital- Bengaluru
 
• Chief Minister- Siddaramaiah
 
• Governor- Thawar Chand Gehlot
 
• State bird- Indian roller
 
• State animal- Elephant
 
• State tree- Sandalwood
 
• State flower- Lotus
 
• State Parks- Anshi National Park, Bandipur National Park, Bannerghatta National Park, Kudremukh National Park, Nagarahole National Park.
